messages:
Sam Lee: Quick rollcall — planning a short release-readiness sync for the v1.8 cut on Thu 2026-03-26. 30min. Asking for stakeholder RSVP and owners for: rollback, post-cut verifications, and postmortem lead. Proposed agenda below. :calendar:

Priya Patel: I can make it. I'll own acceptance criteria and shipping checklist. :+1:

Oliver Chen: Eng-platform will be there. Need to know canary traffic % and timeframe to validate infra scaling.

Maya Ramos: QA confirmed — I'll run the pre-cut smoke suite and own test gating. If I see failures I'll pause the cut and file blockers.

Kenji Ito: SRE oncall here. I'll own canary rollout and rollback plan. Proposing 10% -> 50% over 20m with health checks. If anything >5% error rate, we rollback.

Alex Morgan: I'll schedule the meeting at Thu 10:00 PT and add calendar invites. Please update your RSVP by EOD Tue. Also assigning owners in the agenda section.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview for release v1.8: https://deploy.internal/release/v1.8 (sha: 9fb3d2a). Canary config: `canary-10pct-20m`

Sam Lee: Agenda draft:
```
- Quick status (5m) — blockers and unblock ops
- Acceptance checklist review (5m) — @Priya Patel
- Canary plan & rollback owner (7m) — @Kenji Ito
- Cut decision & calendar sync (5m) — @Alex Morgan
- Post-cut verification owners & postmortem lead (3m) — volunteer
```

Sam Lee: Owners so far — Acceptance: Priya; QA gating: Maya; Canary/Rollback: Kenji; Scheduling: Alex. Need postmortem lead and ops escalation contact.

Priya Patel: I nominate @Oliver Chen for postmortem lead (he can gather traces and infra metrics).

Oliver Chen: happy to take it. I'll collect pre-cut perf baseline and ensure traces are preserved.

Maya Ramos: Ops escalation contact: @Sam Lee (I tag you since you've got prod perms).

Kenji Ito: Can we add a short checklist snippet in the thread so everyone can quickly confirm?

Sam Lee: Good idea. Checklist snippet:
```
- All critical PRs merged and CI green
- Smoke suite passing on staging
- DB migration runbook validated
- Canary config uploaded to infra repo
- Pager duties confirmed
```

Alex Morgan: Adding attendees: Sam, Priya, Oliver, Maya, Kenji, Alex. If anyone else should be looped in (security, legal) speak now. Otherwise I'll send invites.

Priya Patel: Security review cleared for this cut. No legal issues.

Sam Lee: Final ask — reply here with "+1" to confirm you will attend or "-1" if you cannot. I'll lock the agenda Wed EOD.

Priya Patel: +1

Oliver Chen: +1

Maya Ramos: +1

Kenji Ito: +1

Alex Morgan: +1

Sam Lee: Thanks all — calendar invite sent. I'll paste final agenda and runbook link in this thread before the meeting. :rocket:
